title: Reply: a reconceived explanandum can be compared fairly

statements.text: As a heliocentric account replaced the question of where the sun goes at night, a theory that recasts the explanandum can be compared with the prevailing one, and it also explains why people are inclined to think there is an explanatory gap.

sources.quote: It is absolutely fair to compare Jake’s explanation to the prevailing explanation, even if they have different explananda.
